title: Gum soles ignite at golden hour

tokens.v: Put him small in the lower third, mid-step out of deep blue shade into a hard-edged wedge of late sun, so the gum sole and toe cap ignite first while his torso sits two stops down, the torn-poster wall towering out through the top edge. 35mm at f/5.6 from pavement level, tilted up. A lifted sheet of poster paper flares out of focus in the near-right foreground, cut by the right edge. Cropped technical jacket zipped to the sternum over a white tee, wide black trousers cropped at the ankle, the low-tops fully laced. The blank poster panel holds clean above him.
